The fund tracks the Dow Jones U.S. Dividend 100 Index. Expense ratio of 0.06%. Assets under management exceed $50 billion. Net asset value is published daily.

Investors comparing SCHD against VNQ for income should note that REITs carry interest-rate sensitivity that dividend equities do not. Standard deviation and maximum drawdown differ materially between the two. Past performance does not predict future results.

According to fund documents, the strategy screens for quality and free cash flow. TLT is sometimes used alongside it for duration. Source: issuer materials.
